drafts.zu: Izinketho zezitayela zihlala zibonakala; amamephu Amanzi ephepheni elimhlophe agcina ingemuva limhlophe.
drafts.st: Dikgetho tsa setaele di dula di bonahala; dimmapa tsa Metsi tse pampiring e tshweu di boloka bokamorao bo le bosweu.
drafts.ts: Swihlawuriwa swa xitayele swi sala swi vonaka; mimepe ya Mati eka phepha ro basa yi hlayisa le ndzhaku ku basile.
drafts.ve: Zwinangwa zwa zwitaila zwi dzula zwi tshi vhonala; mapa a Maḓi kha bammbiri ḽitshena a vhulunga murahu hu hutshena.
